ice.refresh: Keep strongest active slow and latest expiry; enemies only

chain.policy: Nearest distinct living enemies; once per bullet; armour halves unless pierce is active; no recursive chains

burn.refresh: Keep due tick and strongest active damage; enemies only; ignores armour

runtimeRevision04.combinations: Scatter, pierce, explosion, ice, chain and burn remain independent snapshots on each fired bullet. Direct, splash and arc enemy hits apply ice and burn.
runtimeRevision04.appearance: Highest active element selects core style (burn, chain, ice, explosive, pierce, normal); electric trail and ice collar show combined elements; source barrel cells also remain visible
runtimeRevision04.geometry: Core half-width and half-depth define authoritative sweep. Trails and collars are decorations. Imported body scale and shot height retained from 0.3.
runtimeRevision04.audio: Replace shot, impact and enemy WAVs with noise-free midrange sine sweeps; 16 ms attack, 50 ms release; reduced gains 0.15, 0.11 and 0.22. Preserve foreground/focus mute and conservative mixed headroom.

reinforcements.formation: Two alternating lanes in levels 1-3; three lanes in levels 4-5. Skip a lane already occupied by a base spawn within 0.75 seconds.
reinforcements.records: Merge these reinforcements with the retained base course events, then sort by spawn time.

runtimeRevision03.baseDimensions: Existing artist model and scene dimensions are before the explicit runtime body scale.

handoff.parentReportedAssetUpdate: First batch generated. RunnerTorso is a full figure rather than a separable torso; parent owns correction and asset retention.
handoff.parentReportedWorkflowError: WORKFLOW_RUNTIME_RESUME_INVALID (child Run not waiting); parent handles recovery, designer must not resume workflow or Editor.
handoff.replicationClaim: No original title, video, or screenshot exists. Match confirmed gameplay, not pixel-perfect replication.

forbidden: moving the Stage root/camera to fake running

geometry.axis: X right, Y up, Z toward viewer; runner forward is -Z
geometry.conversion: PhysicalLengthConverter for dp/physical dimensions; Stage metre values remain metres; worldScale=1 candidate verify on device
geometry.placement: session-only placement relative to launch viewer; no plane detection, persistent physical anchor, or cross-session restoration
geometry.comfort: candidate only, seated/standing validate at floor 0.70-0.80 m and near edge 0.80-0.90 m; never claim verified

input.capture: capture pointer/controller id on avatar pick, retain while ray leaves silhouette
input.release: preserve lateral x, release pointer ownership only
input.pause: cancel capture, freeze simulation, preserve x and stacks
input.suspend: pause and discard excess elapsed wall time
input.ray: intersect fixed viewer-facing drag plane through avatar; use delta world X, never absolute jump
input.keyboard: not primary; no manual firing control

loop.autoFire: active only in running; forward parallel shots, no auto route steering
loop.levelReset: HP=100, all stacks=0, lateral x=0, elapsed=0; retry same level; next starts new level, no hidden carryover
loop.missedTargetPenalty: nonterminal enemies/gates cause no damage unless lane collision; missed rewards are lost; terminal survives deadline => failed
loop.armourBypass: pierce stack >0 bypasses armour for direct bullets; splash still armour-reduced
loop.finish: At 60 seconds, won only if HP>0 and terminal defeated, else failed; level 5 victory then complete

boss.targetLane: snapshot nearest lane to avatar at warning start
boss.phase: below half HP interval becomes 2 s; no untelegraphed damage

gateSemantics.number: remaining durability HP, never a positive arithmetic multiplier
gateSemantics.label: DURABILITY
gateSemantics.reward: separate named reward strip with +stack or +HP amount
gateSemantics.hit: subtract effective bullet damage, clamp at 0; number pulses and chips before break
gateSemantics.break: exactly once at HP <=0: remove collider, shatter frame/infill, apply named reward immediately to runner even if not in gate lane; no second pickup required
gateSemantics.unbroken: no reward; lane collision 15 damage, shatter as failure impact without grant; bypassing is permitted
gateSemantics.rewardCaps: cap turns into visible MAX feedback, never decreases another upgrade
gateSemantics.simultaneous: deduplicate target ids and reward grants; collision sweep after projectile damage so a gate broken this tick cannot hurt runner

types.label: 散射
types.description: One stack: 3 lanes of bullets at -0.08/0/+0.08 m; two: 5 at -0.16/-0.08/0/+0.08/+0.16 m.

types.label: 穿透
types.description: Each bullet hits 1 + stack count distinct targets, never the same target twice.

types.label: 爆炸弹
types.description: On first impact, splash radius 0.13/0.18 m at 50%/75% bullet damage; excludes direct target.

types.label: 攻速
types.description: Fire cadence x1.25 per stack, capped at 8 volleys/sec; forward speed is unchanged.

types.label: 护盾
types.description: One charge cancels one collision completely, then consumes one charge. Shield does not absorb missed finish targets.

types.label: 回血
types.description: Immediate +25 HP, capped at 100. Healing is not a persistent weapon stack.

pickups.collection: All SupplyCrates, including speed and shield, have 40 durability and can be shot or damaged by splash. Destroying one grants its reward immediately. An unbroken crate can still be collected on lane overlap at runner depth. Damage resolves before contact and each id grants exactly once.
pickups.weaponVisibility: spread adds lateral muzzle pods, pierce purple barrel collar, blast coral muzzle ring, rate pulsing yellow coil, shield blue orbital arc; heal mint pulse

running.forwardDrift: avatar moves forward by 0.035 m during first 3 s then maintains moving foot/track-relative travel; root remains stable
running.feet: separate leg nodes parented to hip pivots, opposite swing; no requirement for unverified rigged skeleton

scenery.road: Editor primitives: rounded course slab, lane dash segments, rails, safety stripes

layers.name: mid supply pylons and round shrubs

scenery.recycle: pool segments beyond near edge; distance-driven negative depth translation; maintain deterministic seed
scenery.motion: markings flow toward viewer, props scale through projection; never scroll AttachmentPanel or Stage root
scenery.extras: small hover wagons, turning beacon caps, bobbing roadside pods; amplitude <=0.012 m; gameplay is primary

enemy.shape: coral chunks + cream puff ring, no gore

effects.motion: no camera shake, no fullscreen flashes; effects bounded to contact point; preserve target readability
effects.implementation: Editor effect templates + bounded pooled runtime transforms; real animation and particle evidence required from parent

labels.auto: 自动前进 / 自动开火
labels.drag: 按住小人左右拖动，松手后保留位置。
labels.idleHint: 选择路线，小人会自动前进并开火。
labels.fallback: 音效暂不可用，视觉反馈正常。
labels.resultFormat: 破门 {gates} / 击败敌人 {enemies} / 道具 {pickups}
labels.startSubtitle: 击破数字门，叠加火力，持续向前。
labels.rulesCopy: 按住小人左右拖动，松手保留位置。小人自动前进、自动开火。数字是剩余耐久；门打到零立即获得标明的奖励，碰到未破的门会受伤且没有奖励。攻速、护盾等补给箱可打碎立即获得，也能经过拾取，同一箱只奖励一次。散射、穿透、爆炸弹和攻速可叠加组合；护盾抵消一次碰撞，回血恢复25点生命。躲开敌人和路障，在60秒内击破终点目标。每关开始时生命和道具重置。
labels.exitCopy: 本次挑战已结束，准备好后再出发。
labels.loadErrorCopy: 必需模型加载失败。请重试模型或退出；模型就绪前不能开始游戏。
